verdict.rationale: Baseten supports official OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible client SDKs for inference (docs-21, docs-33, docs-39), a Performance Client SDK for Python/JS/Rust (docs-49), and Truss as an official SDK/CLI for packaging and deploying models (baseten-gh-1-8). This covers building against official SDKs for both inference and deployment workflows, though it relies heavily on compatibility with third-party SDKs (OpenAI/Anthropic clients) rather than a fully bespoke first-party SDK ecosystem, and no independent hands-on review of SDK quality/reliability is present. Missing for 10: independent/community validation of SDK robustness, a unified first-party SDK spanning training+inference+deployment, and OpenAPI/schema-based SDK generation (probe shows no openapi spec found).
